profile.headline: Engineering lead — Agent Systems & AI Application Infrastructure | TikTok · ex-Meta
profile.summary:
I build AI applications end to end: the platform that turns a model endpoint into a shipped feature — modular capabilities, orchestration, tooling, observability — and the consumer products that run on it.

I drive cross-platform teams across mobile, server and full stack, at billion-user scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founded and grew the AIGC Architecture team to 20+ people — server, mobile, web and interactive design — and own the platform behind TikTok's AI creation experiences.

• Workflow protocol and orchestration runtime — the shared standard adopted across product departments.
• Agentic execution — model-driven control flow, routing and state, powering creation agents.
• Creator tooling — a visual workflow editor that puts designers in the production pipeline.
• Operations and observability — monitoring and one-click end-to-end diagnosis of any run.
• Lead inventor on the workflow-protocol patent, filed 2026.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

Owned client engineering end to end across iOS, Android and web.

projects.title: Web Service of Lacewing Digital Library (LDL)
projects.description:
• Front-end design using CSS3/HTML5 with jQuery and bootstrap.
• Back-end Implementation with C#, .NET MVC4, and SQL server for 100k+ records.
• Database optimization with Entity Framework for improving searching speed and avoiding SQL injections.

projects.title: Multi-processor Based Movies Recommendation System
projects.description:
• Designed a recommendation system by Collaborative Filtering using C++, MPI under IBM NeXtScale Cluster. 
• Established a latent-factor model and parallelized matrix factorization using Alternating Least Squares (ALS). 
• Tested over 20M movieLens records. Improved processing speed by 300% comparing to sequential algorithms.
